NTPC became a listed company in 2004, with majority holding of 89.50% with the Government of India which was further reduced from time to time. The Company has over the years, developed from a thermal power generator to an integrated power company with presence across entire energy value chain through backward and forward integration into areas such as coal mining power trading, distribution etc. On 19th May 2010, NTPC was granted the status of 'Maharatna' that resulted in enhanced autonomy in decision making. Its registered and corporate offices are at New Delhi. The company employed 16,689 regular employees (Executives: 12,319 and Non- executives: 4,370) as on 31.03.2025. The authorized and paid up capital of the Company was Rs. 16,600 crores and Rs. 9,696.7 crores respectively as on 31.03.2025. Government of India's equity in NTPC, stands at 51.10% as on 31.03.2025, the rest being held by Institutional Investors, public & others. ll. CMD shall lead the formulation and implementation of the Corporation’s long-term vision and strategy, ensure sustainable growth, and align organizational objectives with national priorities.
